title: I used to and I'm used to

vocabulary.meaning_en: did something regularly in the past, but not now
vocabulary.example: I used to stand over there.

vocabulary.meaning_en: be familiar with something; it is not new or strange to you
vocabulary.example: I'm used to cooking my own dinner.
You'll get used to it soon.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not now, although it was true before
vocabulary.example: I used to live there, but not anymore.
Living alone is not strange to me.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the base form of a verb (to go / go)
vocabulary.example: After "used to" use the base verb: used to go.
I live near the airport, so I'm used to the noise.
I'm from Riyadh, so I'm used to the heat.
In fast speech, the d and t blend together: used to.

fine_lines.title: I used to vs I'm used to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I used to + المصدر = كنت أفعل ذلك بانتظام في الماضي ولم أعد أفعله. I'm used to + فعل بـ ing أو اسم = أنا معتاد عليه، ليس جديدًا ولا غريبًا عليّ (الآن).
fine_lines.explanation_en: I used to + base verb = I did it regularly in the past, but not now. I'm used to + -ing or noun = I'm familiar with it; it's not new or strange to me (now).

examples.sentence: I used to live alone. (Now I live with my family.)
I'm used to living alone. (It's normal for me.)

fine_lines.title: be used to vs get used to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: be used to = معتاد بالفعل. get used to = يصبح معتادًا مع الوقت.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Be used to" = already familiar. "Get used to" = become familiar over time.

examples.sentence: I'm used to the cold weather.
You'll get used to the cold weather.

expressions.meaning_en: It is new or strange for me.
expressions.example: I'm standing on the other side today, and I'm not used to it.

expressions.phrase: I used to ..., but not anymore.
expressions.meaning_en: A past habit that has stopped.
expressions.example: I used to drink a lot of coffee, but not anymore.
The new job is hard now, but you'll get used to it.

grammar.title: used to + base verb = past habit
grammar.explanation_ar: الفاعل + used to + المصدر: فعل كنا نقوم به بانتظام في الماضي ولم نعد نفعله. لا يوجد له صيغة مضارع؛ إذا كنت تفعله الآن فلا تستعمله.
grammar.explanation_en: Subject + used to + base verb: something you did regularly in the past and don't do anymore. It has no present form; if you still do it, don't use it.
examples: I used to stand over there.
She used to work in a bank.
We used to play football every Friday.

grammar.title: be used to + -ing / noun = familiar now
grammar.explanation_ar: الفاعل + فعل be (am/is/are) + used to + فعل بـ ing أو اسم: الشيء ليس جديدًا ولا غريبًا عليك. لا يأتي بعده المصدر.
grammar.explanation_en: Subject + be (am/is/are) + used to + -ing or a noun: the thing is not new or strange to you. Don't use the base verb after it.
examples: I'm used to cooking my own food.
He is used to working late.

grammar.title: Pronunciation: used to
grammar.explanation_ar: في الكلام السريع يمتزج صوت d و t فتُنطق used to مثل "يوستا" في الحالتين، لذلك انتبه لوجود فعل be وما يأتي بعدها.
grammar.explanation_en: In fast speech the d and t blend, so "used to" sounds like "yoosta" in both. Listen for "be" and for what comes after.

questions.question: "I ___ live in Cairo, but now I live in Dubai."
questions.explanation_ar: عادة في الماضي توقفت: used to + المصدر.
questions.explanation_en: A past habit that stopped: used to + base verb.

questions.question: "I'm from Riyadh, so I'm used to ___."
"She is used to ___ late."
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: be used to + ing.

questions.question: "I'm used to cooking my own dinner" means ___.
choices: I cooked in the past but stopped.
Cooking my own dinner is normal for me.
questions.explanation_en: It's not new or strange to me.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I am used to wake up early.
I used to waking up early.
I am used to waking up early.
I use to waking up early.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: am used to + ing.

questions.question: "I used to swim every day" means ___.
choices: I swam regularly before, but not now.
Swimming is not strange to me.

questions.question: "The new job is hard, but you'll ___ it."
questions.explanation_ar: get used to = تعتاد مع الوقت.
questions.explanation_en: "Get used to" = become familiar over time.

questions.question: "I'm standing on the other side today. I'm not ___ it."
questions.explanation_ar: not used to it = لست معتادًا عليه.
questions.explanation_en: "Not used to it" = not familiar with it.

questions.question: "We ___ play football every Friday when we were kids."
